We can definitely pause the live session. Two options from our side:

2) Hold the live demo and propose three windows for Aug 10–14 (attached: proposed_windows.ics).

Thanks for the update. We’ll pause scheduling the live walkthrough for now and ship a short recorded demo and the attached one-pager (Redwood_Marketline_onepager_v2.pdf) by EOD today. The recording highlights how we handle cost controls (batching/quantization), routing/fallbacks, and the dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs — the three points CFOs usually ask about.

Laura will add the two CFO-focused slides and I’ll include a tentative calendar invite for Aug 11 10:00am PT (marked "tentative") in case Finance frees the window. If the August date doesn’t work after your planning workshop, let’s re-evaluate during your FY planning follow-up.
